newsitem.title: USA: Isidore gathers strength in eastern Atlantic.
newsitem.headline: Isidore gathers strength in eastern Atlantic.

text.p: Hurricane Isidore gathered strength in the eastern Atlantic on Thursday with winds rising to 85 mph (140 kph), the National Hurricane Centre said.

At 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT), Isidore was about 830 miles (1,350 km) west-southwest of the Cape Verde Islands in the eastern Atlantic at latitude 12.7 north and longitude 36.2 west. It was moving west-northwest at 15 mph (24 kph), forecasters at the hurricane centre said.
It remained several days from land.
Hurricane force winds extended outward up to 30 miles (45 km) from the centre.
Isidore is the seventh hurricane to form this season in the Atlantic.
